description: Turn on/off full computation mode. In full computation mode, moments are balanced by calculating equivalent forces. When turned off, barycentric interpolation is used to calculate the node forces, moments, translational stiffnesses and rotation stiffnesses.
notes: The 6.0 manual documents this command too, but the 6.00 binaries have no coupling commands at all (live top-level command enumeration on the PFC3D 6.00 GUI).
3D only live: the 2D binaries have no wall-structure command (7.00 and 9.8).
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC2D and PFC3D 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (plus the PFC3D 6.00 GUI for the 6.0 verdict) (syntax grade): accepted on PFC3D 7.00 and 9.8.
